title: Applied Linguistics, Minor (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: 18cr exact bulletin match, fully clean -- every candidate course in aplng_catalog.json is genuinely prereq- and concurrent-free, so this pairs cleanly against both verification targets with zero hidden-prereq additions of any kind. The one non-Eberly-Science minor in this batch, picked from the College of the Liberal Arts' own full minor listing (58 real programs surveyed) to diversify the batch beyond a single college and to pair name-for-name with the already-built Applied Linguistics major (code APLNGBA), which had no minor yet. Prescribed Courses (12cr): APLNG 200 + APLNG 290N + APLNG 412 + APLNG 491. Elective Pool -- select 6cr from {APLNG 210, APLNG 220N, APLNG 230N, APLNG 260N, APLNG 280N, APLNG 320N} -- filled with APLNG 320N + APLNG 210, both prereq-free; APLNG 320N was picked specifically because it (along with the prescribed APLNG 290N) is one of only two APLNG codes the already-built APLNGBA major's own flowchart directly requires, maximizing genuine overlap with its natural pairing major. Verified against CMPSC (this catalog's standard baseline) -- plan_progress confirms exactly 18.0cr for the minor:APLNGMIN bucket, no additions needed. Also verified against APLNGBA, where APLNG 290N and APLNG 320N are already independently required (near no-op for those two) while APLNG 200/412/491/210 (12cr) are net-new -- a real, substantive minor addition for that major's own students, unlike the several near-total-overlap pairings found elsewhere in this project (MINEMIN/MINE, FORMIN/FORES).
